mapper.select: SELECT pmj.*, (SELECT unit_name FROM fnd_org_unit fn WHERE fn.unit_id = fe.unit_id) as unit_name, (SELECT position_name FROM fnd_org_position fop WHERE fop.position_id = fe.position_id) as position_name, (SELECT company_short_name FROM fnd_company fc WHERE fc.company_id = fe.company_id) as company_short_name, (SELECT employee_code FROM fnd_employee fee WHERE fe.employee_id = fee.employee_id) as employee_code, (SELECT name FROM fnd_employee fee WHERE fe.employee_id = fee.employee_id) as name FROM prj_meeting_judge pmj,fnd_employee_assigns fe,sys_user_allocation sua WHERE sua.employee_assign_id = fe.employee_assign_id and pmj.judge_user_allocation_id = sua.allocation_id order BY judge_user_allocation_id desc

select * from ( SELECT fe.employee_assign_id, (select max(sua.allocation_id) from sys_user_allocation sua where sua.employee_assign_id = fe.employee_assign_id ) judge_user_allocation_id, (SELECT max(sua.user_id) from sys_user_allocation sua where sua.employee_assign_id = fe.employee_assign_id ) judge_user_id, (SELECT max(sua.company_id) from sys_user_allocation sua where sua.employee_assign_id = fe.employee_assign_id) company_id, (SELECT unit_name FROM fnd_org_unit fn WHERE fn.unit_id = fe.unit_id) as unit_name, (SELECT position_name FROM fnd_org_position fop WHERE fop.position_id = fe.position_id) as position_name, (SELECT company_short_name FROM fnd_company fc WHERE fc.company_id = fe.company_id) as company_short_name, (SELECT employee_code FROM fnd_employee fee WHERE fe.employee_id = fee.employee_id) as employee_code, (SELECT name FROM fnd_employee fee WHERE fe.employee_id = fee.employee_id) as name FROM fnd_employee_assigns fe ) v where v.judge_user_allocation_id is not null
